""" Season calendar and game loop — day-by-day progression, match scheduling. """ from __future__ import annotations
import sqlite3 from datetime import timedelta
from src.data.models import ( GameState, Player, MatchResult, Fixture, InboxMessage, MatchdayOutcome, ) from src.data import queries from src.core import league, match_engine, club as club_module from src.core.player import ( update_form, update_fitness_after_match, rest_recovery, update_morale, ) from src.core.media import ( create_match_report_message, generate_random_event, generate_league_roundup, create_weekly_board_brief_message, ) from src.core.board import ( update_confidence_after_match, get_confidence_level, evaluate_objective_progress, ) from src.core.fans import update_fan_happiness, calculate_attendance from src.core.youth import develop_player from src.core.finance import process_monthly_finances from src.core.transfers import generate_ai_bids, check_expiring_contracts, process_pending_negotiations, process_loan_returns from src.utils.config import MatchEventType, INJURY_TYPES from src.utils import rng
def advance_day(conn: sqlite3.Connection, game_state: GameState) -> list[str]: """ Advance the game by one day.
Returns a list of summary messages about what happened. """ messages: list[str] = [] game_state.current_date += timedelta(days=1) game_state.day_count += 1
# Check if today is a match day (league) is_match_day = False next_matchday = queries.get_next_unplayed_matchday(conn) if next_matchday is not None: fixtures = queries.get_fixtures_by_matchday(conn, next_matchday)
# Check if any fixtures are scheduled for today todays_fixtures = [f for f in fixtures if f.date == game_state.current_date]
if todays_fixtures: is_match_day = True messages.extend(_simulate_matchday(conn, game_state, todays_fixtures))
# ── Cup match simulation ───────────────────────────────────────── try: from src.core.competition import ( get_cup_state, simulate_cup_match_result, advance_cup_round, CUP_NAME, is_cup_match, ) cup = get_cup_state(conn, game_state.season_year) if cup and not cup.is_complete: # Find today's cup fixtures (non-user matches only) cup_rows = conn.execute( """SELECT id FROM fixtures WHERE competition=? AND played=0 AND match_date=? AND home_club_id != ? AND away_club_id != ?""", (CUP_NAME, game_state.current_date.isoformat(), game_state.user_club_id, game_state.user_club_id), ).fetchall() for row in cup_rows: simulate_cup_match_result(conn, row["id"], cup)
# Try advancing the round cup_msgs = advance_cup_round(conn, cup, game_state) messages.extend(cup_msgs) except Exception: pass # Cup not available yet
# ── Ramadan notification (once per Ramadan period) ──────────────── from src.utils.config import is_ramadan if is_ramadan(game_state.current_date) and game_state.day_count % 30 == 1: from src.utils.localization import t queries.insert_message(conn, InboxMessage( date=game_state.current_date, subject=" Ramadan Mubarak", body=t("ramadan_notice") + "\n\n" + t("ramadan_schedule"), category="general", )) messages.append("Ramadan period — fitness and training affected.")
# Daily fitness recovery and injury healing for ALL clubs (every day) _daily_recovery(conn, game_state)
# Process pending transfer negotiations (responses arrive) messages.extend(process_pending_negotiations(conn, game_state))
# Process loan returns messages.extend(process_loan_returns(conn, game_state))
# AI transfer offers for listed players (daily) messages.extend(generate_ai_bids(conn, game_state))
# Weekly player development (every 7 days) if game_state.day_count % 7 == 0: messages.extend(_weekly_development(conn, game_state)) messages.extend(_weekly_board_brief(conn, game_state))
# Monthly finances + contract checks (every 30 days) if game_state.day_count % 30 == 0: messages.extend(_monthly_finances(conn, game_state)) messages.extend(check_expiring_contracts(conn, game_state))
# Random mid-season events (varied inbox messages) squad = queries.get_players_by_club(conn, game_state.user_club_id) if squad: random_player = rng.choice(squad) event_msg = generate_random_event( game_state.user_club_name, random_player.name, game_state.current_date, ) if event_msg: queries.insert_message(conn, event_msg)
# Interactive random events (stored on app_state for UI to display) from src.core.events import generate_daily_event daily_event = generate_daily_event(conn, game_state) if daily_event: try: from src.ui.app import app_state app_state.pending_event = daily_event except Exception: pass
# Check season completion if league.is_season_complete(conn): champion = league.get_champion(conn) if champion: msg = f"Season complete! {champion.club_name} are champions with {champion.points} points!" messages.append(msg) queries.insert_message(conn, InboxMessage( date=game_state.current_date, subject=" Season Over!", body=msg, category="general", ))
queries.save_game_state(conn, game_state)
# Autosave check try: row = conn.execute("SELECT auto_save, auto_save_interval FROM game_settings WHERE id = 1").fetchone() if row and row["auto_save"] and game_state.day_count % row["auto_save_interval"] == 0: queries.save_game_state(conn, game_state) except Exception: pass

def advance_to_next_match(conn: sqlite3.Connection, game_state: GameState) -> list[str]: """ Fast-forward to the next match day for the user's club. Simulates all intermediate days. """ all_messages: list[str] = [] max_days = 60 # Safety limit
for _ in range(max_days): # Check if user has a match today user_fixture = queries.get_user_next_fixture(conn, game_state.user_club_id) if user_fixture and user_fixture.date == game_state.current_date: break
day_messages = advance_day(conn, game_state) all_messages.extend(day_messages)
if league.is_season_complete(conn): break

for fixture in fixtures: # Skip user's match — they handle it via the UI is_user_match = ( fixture.home_club_id == game_state.user_club_id or fixture.away_club_id == game_state.user_club_id )
if is_user_match: continue
result = _simulate_single_fixture(conn, fixture) results.append((fixture, result)) msg = result.score_display messages.append(msg)
# Update league standings if results: league.process_matchday_results(conn, results)

# Update player stats _update_player_stats_after_match(conn, result, home_squad, away_squad, home_tactics, away_tactics) return result

if row: if a_goals > b_goals: conn.execute(""" UPDATE head_to_head SET club_a_wins = club_a_wins + 1, club_a_goals = club_a_goals + ?, club_b_goals = club_b_goals + ? WHERE club_a_id = ? AND club_b_id = ? """, (a_goals, b_goals, club_a_id, club_b_id)) elif b_goals > a_goals: conn.execute(""" UPDATE head_to_head SET club_b_wins = club_b_wins + 1, club_a_goals = club_a_goals + ?, club_b_goals = club_b_goals + ? def _row_to_fixture(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Fixture: """Convert a DB row to a Fixture model.""" result = None def _safe_str(col, default=""): try: val = row[col] return val if val is not None else default except (IndexError, KeyError): return default
if row["played"]: events = [] if row["events_json"]: raw_events = json.loads(row["events_json"]) events = [MatchEvent(**e) for e in raw_events] home_stats = MatchStats(**json.loads(row["home_stats_json"])) if row["home_stats_json"] != '{}' else MatchStats() away_stats = MatchStats(**json.loads(row["away_stats_json"])) if row["away_stats_json"] != '{}' else MatchStats()

submitted_starting_xi: list[int] = [] submitted_bench: list[int] = [] try: raw_xi = row["submitted_starting_xi_json"] if raw_xi: submitted_starting_xi = [int(pid) for pid in json.loads(raw_xi)] except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError): submitted_starting_xi = [] try: raw_bench = row["submitted_bench_json"] if raw_bench: submitted_bench = [int(pid) for pid in json.loads(raw_bench)] except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError): submitted_bench = []
return Fixture( fixture_id=row["id"], matchday=row["matchday"], home_club_id=row["home_club_id"], away_club_id=row["away_club_id"], home_club_name=row["home_club_name"], away_club_name=row["away_club_name"], home_club_name_ar=_safe_str("home_club_name_ar"), away_club_name_ar=_safe_str("away_club_name_ar"), date=date.fromisoformat(row["match_date"]) if row["match_date"] else None, played=bool(row["played"]), result=result, competition=row["competition"], submitted_starting_xi=submitted_starting_xi, submitted_bench=submitted_bench, )

# Look up the player's current wage so we can adjust wage bills row = conn.execute("SELECT wage_weekly FROM players WHERE id = ?", (player_id,)).fetchone() old_wage = row["wage_weekly"] if row else 0

def update_head_to_head(conn: sqlite3.Connection, club_a_id: int, club_b_id: int, a_goals: int, b_goals: int) -> None: """Update head-to-head record after a match. Always store with smaller ID as club_a.""" if club_a_id > club_b_id: club_a_id, club_b_id = club_b_id, club_a_id a_goals, b_goals = b_goals, a_goals
row = conn.execute( "SELECT * FROM head_to_head WHERE club_a_id = ? AND club_b_id = ?", (club_a_id, club_b_id) ).fetchone()
if row: if a_goals > b_goals: conn.execute(""" UPDATE head_to_head SET club_a_wins = club_a_wins + 1, club_a_goals = club_a_goals + ?, club_b_goals = club_b_goals + ? WHERE club_a_id = ? AND club_b_id = ? """, (a_goals, b_goals, club_a_id, club_b_id)) elif b_goals > a_goals: conn.execute(""" UPDATE head_to_head SET club_b_wins = club_b_wins + 1, club_a_goals = club_a_goals + ?, club_b_goals = club_b_goals + ? WHERE club_a_id = ? AND club_b_id = ? """, (a_goals, b_goals, club_a_id, club_b_id)) else: conn.execute(""" UPDATE head_to_head SET draws = draws + 1, club_a_goals = club_a_goals + ?, club_b_goals = club_b_goals + ? WHERE club_a_id = ? AND club_b_id = ? """, (a_goals, b_goals, club_a_id, club_b_id)) else: a_wins = 1 if a_goals > b_goals else 0 b_wins = 1 if b_goals > a_goals else 0 draws = 1 if a_goals == b_goals else 0 conn.execute(""" INSERT INTO head_to_head (club_a_id, club_b_id, club_a_wins, club_b_wins, draws, club_a_goals, club_b_goals) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) """, (club_a_id, club_b_id, a_wins, b_wins, draws, a_goals, b_goals)) conn.commit()

row = conn.execute( "SELECT * FROM head_to_head WHERE club_a_id = ? AND club_b_id = ?", (club_a_id, club_b_id) ).fetchone()
